metadata.title: Synthetic flight · Lake Annecy
metadata.description: 90-second synthetic paragliding excerpt above Planfait, France: straight glides, a +45-degree entry turn (0:20–0:28), a +40-degree right departure turn (1:00–1:08, 5 degrees/second), leaving 40 degrees right of the thermal entry heading, sink, lift and exactly two 16-second air-relative thermal rotations in one 32-second section (0:28–1:00), at 22.5 degrees/second without roll ramps. The synchronized 90-second video is a generated test pattern, not flight-camera footage.
